name: THECOO Inc.
summary: THECOO Inc., formed in 2014 with its base in Tokyo, Japan, creates and manages fan community platforms. Fanicon is a membership-based mobile app linking fans with their favorite icons. The company also offers Studio Coup, an agency for game commentator influencers, iCON Suite for assessing influencer value, iCON CAST for connecting YouTubers with businesses, RIPPLY for influencer marketing, and online advertising consultation.
